prompt:
Create a finished illustration for a public book-summary library for adult readers. Use a calm, contemporary illustrated-book style: hand-painted gouache, soft matte pigment, restrained pencil details, and a subtle warm ivory paper texture. Use a consistent palette of muted sage and olive green, warm ochre, natural wood brown, and warm ivory, with dark brown or charcoal details. Keep saturation restrained and lighting soft and natural. Give the scene generous breathing room, a clear focal point, and simple, recognizable forms that remain readable on a phone. When people are relevant, depict believable adults with natural proportions, respectful expressions, and ordinary clothing. Use the same medium, palette, texture, and level of detail across the illustration. Avoid photorealism, glossy 3D, neon colors, cinematic effects, heavy black outlines, childish clipart, ornamental clutter, and a different art style in each panel. No readable text, captions, logos, watermarks, fake book covers, or invented author portraits. Keep all explanations and essential labels outside the generated image.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: square book-summary hero, 1024 by 1024. Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its gouache medium, paper texture, warm restrained palette, soft light, and visual density; do not copy its person or study setting. Subject: an imagined late-1970s minicomputer engineering laboratory, relevant to The Soul of a New Machine by Tracy Kidder. Two ordinary adult engineers in plain period shirts, one standing and one seated, quietly examining a large green printed circuit board beside an open waist-high cream-colored minicomputer cabinet with a few clearly drawn circuit boards in card slots. A separate bulky CRT terminal with a blank dark screen sits on a plain lab bench. Focus on the relationship between people, circuit board, and cabinet. Balanced square composition, three-quarter view, generous ivory space, subjects comfortably inside the edges. Render board components as simple small rectangular dark packages; no modern laptops, smartphones, RGB lighting, or futuristic screens. This is a conceptual historical illustration, not a likeness of Tom West or a reconstruction of a documented event. Clear natural hands and anatomy; restrained, uncluttered laboratory.
